title: Trust Administrator
description:
Location: Beaminster

Salary £27k-£32k DOE (will pay more for experienced Trust administrator)

Hours: 9am-5.30pm Mon-Thurs, 9am-5pm Fri

Benefits: 25 days hols + Bank hols (including 3 for Christmas shutdown), birthday off, no onsite parking but provide car parking permit for local car park, pension, medical insurance after probation, social events during the year

Aspire Jobs are delighted to be working in an exclusive partnership with our professional services client who are a well-established and growing firm based in West Dorset. They are seeking to recruit a Trust Administrator to join their busy team. This is a perfect time to join a growing and progressive thinking team and firm.

Are you an organised administrator with excellent attention to detail? Do you enjoy working with figures, managing accurate records and being part of a professional team?

Perhaps you already have experience within legal services, finance or trust administration or from within a professional services firm. Or maybe you're looking for the opportunity to develop specialist knowledge in a highly regarded firm where full training will be provided.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established Trusts department in a varied role offering long-term career development.

The Role

Working as part of a busy and supportive team, you'll help administer a portfolio of trusts, ensuring everything is managed accurately, efficiently and in line with legal requirements.

No two days are quite the same and you'll be involved in a wide range of administrative and financial tasks. As this is a new role you will be setting up systems and spreadsheets from scratch so a real chance to make the role your own.

Responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with the administration of trusts
- Maintaining accurate records and documentation
- Processing financial transactions
- Preparing trust accounts and supporting financial administration
- Liaising with clients and professional advisers
- Ensuring deadlines are met and files remain compliant
- Providing general administrative support to the Trusts team

About You

We're much more interested in finding the right person than someone with previous trust experience.

You'll probably have:
- Previous administration experience
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good numerical ability and confidence working with figures
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- A methodical approach to your work
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office particularly Excel

Experience within a legal practice, financial services, accountancy or trust administration would be an advantage but is by no means essential, as full training will be provided.

title: Trainee Office Administrator
description:
Trainee Office Administrator Job in Ferndown

(Must be a UK resident/have full right to work in the UK)

Dovetail Recruitment are proud to be working with a local business that is looking for a Trainee Office Administrator to join their team in Ferndown. We have personally met with this client, and what is clear is how passionate they are about their business and the local area. They are looking to welcome someone into their small but friendly team to support the next stage of the company's long-term growth.

We are looking for a Trainee Office Administrator to join the business and become an integral part of the team. Full in-house coaching and training is provided, ensuring you have all the tools and support needed to succeed.

Duties and Responsibilities
- Liaising with clients to obtain advertising copy, artwork and approvals.
- Proofread copy and check for errors.
- Keeping the CRM system, project boards and sales lists up to date.
- Checking publications before print to ensure adverts are correct and accounted for.
- Maintaining postal invoice lists and taking card payments.
- Responding to client queries and building positive customer relationships.
- Preparing and distributing sales literature with the design team.
- Supporting sales of programmes and guides.
- Sourcing competition prizes.

This role has the potential to evolve into a sales position should the candidate want to pursue that career trajectory.

Skills and Experience Required
- A confident communicator who enjoys building relationships
- Excellent attention to detail, able to spot errors
- Good grammar skills
- Self-motivated and organised

Salary and details:
- Salary of £25,000
- Working hours: Monday to Thursday, 9.00am - 4.30pm, with a 4.00pm finish on Fridays
- Pension contributions
- Free parking
- 20 days holiday + bank holidays
- Supportive team environment

If you are looking for a Trainee Office Administrator role, this position would be the perfect step to gaining experience, settling into a business and developing your career long term within a local business.

Please submit your CV for our review, or contact Laura at Dovetail Recruitment for more information.

title: French Speaking Customer Service Administrator - 12 month FTC
description:
As a French Speaking Customer Service Administrator, you'll play a key role in coordinating and managing freight operations from Poole. Your day-to-day will involve liaising with clients, organising shipments, and ensuring smooth logistics to keep everything running seamlessly.

Client Details

An organisation within the transport and distribution industry, based in Poole.

Description
- Plan and coordinate freight shipments to ensure timely delivery.
- Communicate with clients and partners in both English and French to manage logistics requirements.
- Monitor and track shipments to ensure accuracy and resolve any issues that arise.
- Maintain and update records of shipments and related documentation.
- Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth operations and compliance with regulations.
- Provide excellent customer service and support to clients.
- Collaborate with other departments to optimise freight processes and improve efficiency.
- Report on freight operations and suggest improvements where necessary.

Profile

A successful French Speaking Customer Service Administrator should have:
- Fluency in both French and English, with excellent communication skills in both languages.
- Previous experience in freight planning, logistics, or a related role within the transport and distribution industry.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- The ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Good problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to challenges.
- Proficiency with relevant software and systems for freight planning and documentation.

Job Offer
- Salary range of £26,400 - £27,400, dependent on the level of experience.
- Fixed-term contract offering stability and a clear scope of responsibilities.
- Opportunities to work within the transport and distribution industry in Poole.
- Potential for further career development in freight planning and logistics.
- Hybrid working available once you have passed training.

title: Sales Administrator
company: Two Six Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Sales Administrator

Poole £25,000 - £28,000 Permanent

TwoSix Recruitment are recruiting for a Sales Administrator to join a small, established business in Poole.

You'll be working closely with the Sales Manager, dealing with customers, preparing quotes, processing orders and keeping the sales admin organised and up to date.

The role at a glance
- £25,000 - £28,000 depending on experience
- Friday 4pm finish
- Monday to Thursday 8.30am - 5.00pm
- Permanent, full-time role
- Full training on the products and systems
- Small team and a varied workload

This isn't a cold calling role and you won't have an individual sales target. You will, however, be speaking to customers regularly, so you need to be comfortable picking up the phone and dealing with enquiries.

You don't need experience of the company's industry or products as you'll be trained.

What you'll be doing
- Dealing with customer enquiries by phone and email
- Preparing quotes and processing sales orders
- Keeping customers updated on orders and deliveries
- Following up outstanding quotes
- Updating customer information on the CRM
- Using Excel spreadsheets to track leads and information
- Keeping sales records and documentation up to date
- Logging customer queries and complaints
- Supporting the Sales Manager with general administration
- Helping out in other areas when needed

What we're looking for

You'll ideally have experience in sales administration, sales support, customer service or order processing.

You'll need to be:
- Good with Excel and spreadsheets
- Confident speaking to customers
- Organised with good attention to detail
- Used to working with a CRM or customer database
- A good communicator
- Comfortable working in a small team
- Someone who follows things through and doesn't let things get missed

Experience preparing quotes or processing customer orders would be useful.

Interested? Apply today with your CV and Vicki Reeks will be in touch to discuss the role with you in more detail.

title: Operations Coordinator
company: Two Six Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Operations Co-ordinator

£28,000 - £33,000 DOE Permanent Full Time

TwoSix Recruitment are looking for an Operations Co-ordinator to join a busy and growing business within the IT sector.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys organising people, managing changing priorities and keeping a busy operation moving.

You could already be working in operations or service coordination. Alternatively, you may come from an IT helpdesk or service desk background and be looking to move into a broader operations-focused role.

The role at a glance
- £28,000 - £33,000 depending on experience
- 23 days holiday + bank holidays, increasing with service
- Employer pension contribution
- Additional benefits with length of service
- Opportunity to develop your career

What you'll be doing

You'll be helping to coordinate a busy team of IT engineers and support staff, making sure work is allocated, prioritised and kept moving.

Your day will include:
- Allocating and scheduling work to engineers
- Prioritising support tickets, jobs and projects
- Monitoring workloads and chasing progress
- Reorganising schedules when priorities change
- Keeping customers updated
- Liaising with engineers, customers and suppliers
- Making sure urgent issues are picked up quickly
- Keeping the CRM and ticketing system up to date

This isn't a role where you'll just be doing general administration.

You'll need to be comfortable making decisions, speaking to engineers and customers and changing priorities throughout the day when something more urgent comes in.

What we're looking for

You don't need formal qualifications and you don't need to be an IT expert.

We're more interested in whether you can organise, prioritise, communicate and keep your head when things get busy.

You may currently be working as an:
- Operations Co-ordinator
- Service Co-ordinator
- IT Co-ordinator
- Helpdesk Co-ordinator
- Service Desk Co-ordinator
- Engineering Co-ordinator
- 1st or 2nd Line IT Support Engineer looking for progression

You'll need to be:
- Highly organised
- Confident and professional
- Comfortable juggling several priorities at once
- A strong communicator
- Calm when plans suddenly change
- Confident using CRM, ticketing or job management systems
- Proactive and able to think for yourself

Previous experience within IT would be an advantage, but strong coordination experience is just as important.

If you're the person who naturally keeps everyone organised, knows what needs dealing with next and makes sure nothing gets forgotten, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today and Vicki Reeks at TwoSix Recruitment will be in touch.
